reviews.text: I had a similar app on my last iPhone and I was able to download any video from YouTube but now it’s not allowing me to download videos or music that I want to use to make edits or videos for my own YouTube channel. This app sucks. I can’t gain access to what I need. if these stupid creators of this app don’t fix this app, I swear I’m gonna delete it in a few months if they don’t and just find an app that allows me to download the stuff I need. I do not recommend anyone downloading this app. It sucks ***.
